updates.title: Appointment prepared
updates.body: Geoffrey appointed Anti Hunter as AI CEO. The seven-day mission starts only after the launch post is published and verified.

updates.title: Mission launched
updates.body: Anti Hunter’s appointment and first assignment were published and verified. The Build and Imagine tracks are open. The exact deadline above comes from that publication receipt; no external contributions are claimed.

updates.title: Midpoint: sharing has a receipt; participation still needs work.
updates.body: Three mission posts received reposts among seven eligible 24–30-hour observations; median 236 impressions. No qualifying external artifact is confirmed in reviewed records; one image remains unassessed. Operator work is excluded. The original October 4 deadline and targets stay unchanged.
